daily.brief: 過去約25.5小時內，60個帳號發出253則相關帖文。共同看好最明顯的是$AMZN（4個帳號），AWS超預期、產能仍受供應限制是主要理由，@OptionsMike關注225附近；$AAPL亦有4個帳號看多。共同看淡只有$INTC（2個帳號），@OptionsMike提到52附近。最大分歧在$GOOGL同$TSLA。
daily.full:
共識

今日共同看好最集中的是$AMZN，4個帳號明確看多，相關帖文17則。@OptionsMike說零售端未達預期但AWS超出預期，指引2027年40%成長、2028年再度大幅成長，資本支出是一生一次機會，大幅反彈，關注225附近。原帖 @TheTranscript_提到AWS約每14秒安裝一顆AI加速器，產能仍受供應限制，客戶吸收速度很快，核心運算與儲存營收成長率達數年來最快。原帖 @Mr_Derivatives則指$META、$GOOGL與$AMZN均低於50日與200日移動平均線，歷史上在主要均線以下買入這些優質股票通常獲得回報，除非預期更深層的2022年式熊市回撤。原帖

$AAPL有4個帳號看多。@charliebilello表示蘋果現在是今年唯一跑贏標普500的Magnificent 7股票，因為它產生比任何其他Mag 7公司更多的自由現金流，同時基本上避免了正在消耗其超大規模同業的資本支出。原帖 @bespokeinvest指出大型科技股近期走勢分歧，$AAPL與$MSFT是僅有的兩檔處於上升趨勢者。原帖 @JC_ParetsX則提到買入時獲得不錯的買盤。原帖

$META有2個帳號看多，@OptionsMike說債務債務債務，但他們在Muse上表現出色，會開始小幅買入，理解它可能跌至540或更低，那將是撿便宜。原帖 $QQQ亦有2個帳號看多，@spotgamma建議做多賣出看跌期權，波動率可能下降。原帖

共同看淡

今日唯一共同看淡是$INTC（2個帳號）。@OptionsMike說糟糕，一團亂，想成為人工智慧公司卻將可怕指引歸咎於PC銷售，所以不是人工智慧公司，巨大的島形頂，52附近感覺有可能，除非有大型晶片商出手拯救其糟糕的晶圓代工。原帖 @TheOneLanceB則問為何Intel在業績後暴跌，以及本週關注什麼。原帖

分歧

$GOOGL1多1淡，帖文17則。@TheTranscript_引述Alphabet執行長：Google每分鐘處理320億AI令牌，同比增長超過4倍，第一方模型API每分鐘近320億令牌，比上季多40%，比一年前多超過4倍。原帖 但@OptionsMike說財報極差，護城河正在侵蝕，廣告／搜尋／YouTube未達預期，明年資本支出大幅提高且自由現金流為負，或許273能守住，關注死貓反彈。原帖

$TSLA2多1淡。@OptionsMike說週五走勢堅挺，收在8日線上方且高於所有均線，若反彈則關注410，相對較強標的。原帖 @TrendSpider說特斯拉終於突破其2026年下跌趨勢。原帖 但@garyblack00擔心電動車市佔率已由80%穩步下降至目前的52%，是誰獲得了市佔？數學上必須等於100%，因此若非所列7家，必有其他業者獲得市佔。原帖

$MSFT3多1淡。@OptionsMike說財報出色，且是唯一現金流為正的超大規模雲端商，但隨後宣佈至少250億美元債券發行，視其為反彈時首選，並關注50日線。原帖 @Mr_Derivatives表示今年早些時候他全面看好MSFT，稱其為美妙的底部。原帖

$SPY2多1淡。@Stephanie_Link指10月統計SPX下跌93個基點，但11個板塊中有9個上漲，突破50日移動平均線的股票從20%升至61%。原帖 @OddStats提到年至今上升+10.7%，歷史上同期升幅後全年餘下時間僅3次為負。原帖 但有帳號指出這是過去40年來第9次標普500至10月底至少有6個負值日曆月份。

其他值得留意

加密相關的$COIN同$HOOD各1多1淡。@TrendSpider對$COIN指出僅做多演算法回測期間+74%，而股票同期下跌63%；對$HOOD則有策略回測回報+1,072%對比買入持有+849%。但@OptionsMike因財報平淡加上幣安駭客事件看淡，對$HOOD稱週五低點為支撐，否則或看73。原帖 整體上，財報後的大型科技股分化明顯，AI敘事仍在，但個股基本面與技術位置成為主要分歧點。

共識

過去一週共同看好最集中的是$SOFI，8個帳號看多。@OptionsMike說財報很好，且在大幅回落後容易反彈，需站上200日線；若再度下跌下方有缺口。原帖 @Jake__Wujastyk指出月線蠟燭有相當的恢復。原帖 $SKHY有5個帳號看多，記憶體產能討論持續。 $LLY與$IWM各有5及4個帳號看多，@OptionsMike視醫藥為防禦標的，關注160突破；小型股守住均線，270為支撐。原帖

共同看淡

共同看淡首位是$RDDT（9個帳號）。@KobeissiLetter指昨日與Reddit首席執行官的業績電話會議將被引用多年，在8個交易日內下跌42%，AI已經永遠地擾亂了搜索以及更廣泛的互聯網。原帖 $NOW有6個帳號看淡，@OptionsMike說財報毫無可取之處，質疑100能否守住。原帖 $CRWV有5個帳號看淡。

分歧

本週分歧名單有多個代號。大型科技股在財報後出現明顯分化，部分帳號聚焦技術位置與現金流，部分則擔心資本支出與市佔變化。指數層面多空並存，沒有出現單向共識。$INTC2多16淡，分歧特別大。

其他值得留意

記憶體與半導體相關討論在週內持續，與財報後網路／半導體殺跌並存。@OptionsMike把$LLY等醫藥名稱視為防禦標的。

monthly.full:
共識

過去一個月共同看好最集中的是$SOFI（9個帳號），金融科技與財報後形態討論延續至月度框架。 $LLY與$MA各有6個帳號看多；@APompliano引述觀點認為禮來將成為全球最有價值的公司，受惠於每年持續的醫療支出加上大量AI投資。原帖 支付與消費相關名稱亦進入共同看好前列，反映輪動與防禦主題。

共同看淡

$RDDT以9個帳號成為月度共同看淡首位，與近七日及今日窗對齊；AI擾亂搜索的敘事持續。原帖 $BA仍有4個帳號看淡。其他包括$FTNT、$RBLX等。

分歧

月度分歧名單廣泛。AI相關名稱與大型科技在資本支出、現金流與技術位置上持續出現多空對話，沒有形成單一方向共識。指數層面同樣多空並陳，$SPY16多13淡，$CRWV3多23淡。

其他值得留意

月度框架上，消費金融、支付與部分防禦名稱較常出現在共同看好側，而財報後回撤的成長股則更容易進入共同看淡。AI敘事仍主導提及量，但個股分化大於指數單一方向。

daily.full:
Consensus

Clearest common bullish today is $AMZN, with 4 accounts long and 17 related posts. @OptionsMike said retail missed but AWS beat expectations, guiding 40% growth in 2027 and another big step-up in 2028; capex is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, sharp bounce, watching near 225. post @TheTranscript_ noted AWS installing an AI accelerator about every 14 seconds, capacity still supply-constrained, customers absorbing quickly, core compute and storage revenue growth at multi-year highs. post @Mr_Derivatives pointed out $META, $GOOGL and $AMZN are all below 50-day and 200-day moving averages; historically buying quality names below major MAs has paid off unless expecting a deeper 2022-style bear market drawdown. post

$AAPL has 4 bullish accounts. @charliebilello said Apple is now the only Magnificent 7 stock outperforming the S&P 500 this year because it generates more free cash flow than any other Mag 7 company while largely avoiding the capex consuming its hyperscale peers. post @bespokeinvest noted large tech divergence, with $AAPL and $MSFT the only two in uptrends. post @JC_ParetsX mentioned decent buying on dips. post

$META has 2 bullish accounts. @OptionsMike said debt debt debt, but they are performing well on Muse, will start small buys, understanding it could fall to 540 or lower, which would be a bargain. post $QQQ also has 2, with @spotgamma suggesting long via selling puts as volatility may decline. post

Common Bearish

Only common bearish today is $INTC (2 accounts). @OptionsMike called it a mess, wanting to be an AI company but blaming terrible guidance on PC sales, so not an AI company, massive island top, near 52 feels possible unless a large chipmaker bails out its foundry. post @TheOneLanceB asked why Intel crashed after earnings and what to watch this week. post

Divergence

$GOOGL 1 long 1 short, 17 posts. @TheTranscript_ quoted Alphabet CEO: Google processes 32 billion AI tokens per minute, up over 4x year-over-year, first-party model API near 32 billion tokens per minute, up 40% from last quarter and over 4x from a year ago. post But @OptionsMike said earnings were terrible, moat eroding, ads/search/YouTube missed, next year capex up sharply and FCF negative, perhaps 273 can hold, watching dead cat bounce. post

$TSLA 2 long 1 short. @OptionsMike said Friday action was firm, closed above 8-day and all MAs, watching 410 on bounce, relatively strong. post @TrendSpider said Tesla finally broke its 2026 downtrend. post But @garyblack00 worries EV market share has steadily fallen from 80% to 52%, who gained share? Math requires 100%, so others must have taken share. post

$MSFT 3 long 1 short. @OptionsMike said earnings strong and the only hyperscaler with positive cash flow, but then announced at least $25B bond issuance, sees it as preferred on bounce, watching 50-day. post @Mr_Derivatives said earlier this year he was fully bullish on MSFT, calling it a beautiful bottom. post

$SPY 2 long 1 short. @Stephanie_Link noted October stats: SPX down 93 bps but 9 of 11 sectors up, stocks above 50-day rose from 20% to 61%. post @OddStats mentioned YTD +10.7%, historically only 3 times negative for the rest of the year after such gains. post But one account noted this is the 9th time in 40 years the S&P 500 had at least 6 negative calendar months by end of October.

Other Notable

Crypto-related $COIN and $HOOD each 1 long 1 short. @TrendSpider noted for $COIN a long-only algo backtest +74% while stock down 63%; for $HOOD strategy +1,072% vs buy-and-hold +849%. But @OptionsMike is bearish due to flat earnings plus Binance hack, for $HOOD Friday low as support or else watching 73. post Overall, large tech post-earnings divergence is clear, AI narrative persists, but individual fundamentals and technical levels are the main points of disagreement.

Consensus

Clearest common bullish over the past week is $SOFI, with 8 accounts long. @OptionsMike said earnings were good and easy to bounce after the big pullback, needs to reclaim the 200-day; gap below if it falls again. post @Jake__Wujastyk noted the monthly candle shows decent recovery. post $SKHY has 5 accounts long, with ongoing memory capacity discussion. $LLY and $IWM have 5 and 4 respectively; @OptionsMike views pharma as defensive, watching 160 break; small caps holding MAs, 270 as support. post

Consensus

Clearest common bullish over the past month is $SOFI (9 accounts), with fintech and post-earnings pattern discussion continuing into the monthly frame. $LLY and $MA each have 6 accounts long; @APompliano quoted the view that Eli Lilly could become the world's most valuable company, benefiting from ongoing healthcare spending plus heavy AI investment. post Payment and consumer names also entered the common bullish list, reflecting rotation and defensive themes.

Common Bearish

$RDDT leads monthly common bearish with 9 accounts, aligned with the 7-day and daily windows; the AI disrupting search narrative persists. post $BA still has 4 accounts bearish. Others include $FTNT, $RBLX.

Divergence

Monthly split list is broad. AI-related names and large tech continue to show long/short dialogue on capex, cash flow and technical levels, no single-direction consensus. Index level similarly mixed, $SPY 16 long 13 short, $CRWV 3 long 23 short.

Other Notable

On the monthly frame, consumer finance, payments and some defensive names more often appear on the common bullish side, while post-earnings growth pullbacks more easily enter common bearish. AI narrative still dominates mention volume, but individual stock divergence exceeds any single index direction.
